description: Repository class for managing team event types, including retrieval, deletion, and association operations using Prisma ORM in a NestJS application.

classes.name: TeamsEventTypesRepository
classes.description: Repository class for handling team event type data operations.

methods.name: getTeamEventType
methods.description: Fetches a specific team event type by ID.

methods.name: getTeamEventTypeBySlug
methods.description: Retrieves a team event type by team ID and slug, with optional hosts limit.

methods.name: getEventTypeByTeamIdAndSlug
methods.description: Finds an event type by team ID and slug.

methods.name: getEventTypeByTeamIdAndSlugWithOwnerAndTeam
methods.description: Retrieves an event type with owner and team details.

methods.name: getTeamEventTypes
methods.description: Lists all event types for a team, optionally sorted by creation date.

methods.name: getEventTypeById
methods.description: Fetches an event type by its ID.

methods.name: getEventTypeChildren
methods.description: Retrieves child event types of a given event type.

methods.name: getEventTypeByIdWithChildren
methods.description: Fetches an event type along with its children.

methods.name: deleteUserManagedTeamEventTypes
methods.description: Deletes event types managed by a user within a team.

methods.name: removeUserFromTeamEventTypesHosts
methods.description: Removes a user from team event type hosts.

methods.name: getByIdIncludeHostsAndUserDefaultSchedule
methods.description: Retrieves an event type with host and user default schedule info.
